SELECT savt.sys_ai_vincent_task_condition, CONCAT(IFNULL(sp.sys_project_location_oss_address, 'http://127.0.0.1:11245'), '/', savt.sys_ai_vincent_task_local_url) sysAiVincentTaskLocalUrl, savt.sys_ai_vincent_task_request_id, savt.sys_ai_vincent_task_status, savt.sys_ai_vincent_task_type, savt.sys_ai_vincent_task_url, savt.create_time
FROM sys_ai_vincent_task savt INNER JOIN sys_project sp ON sp.sys_project_id = savt.sys_project_id WHERE savt.sys_ai_vincent_task_type = #{sysAiVincentTaskType} AND savt.create_by = #{userId} ORDER BY savt.create_time DESC
